* Documents

Each link should open a rendered preview in the browser. The filename header
should identify the original source. Browser Back returns to this page.

- [[file:notes.org][Org: tasks, tags, drawers and highlighted code]]
- [[file:notes.md][Markdown: headings, a table and highlighted code]]
- [[file:document.docx][DOCX: formatted text, a table and relative document links]]
- [[file:plain.txt][Plain text: literal text without interpreting markup]]
- [[file:hello.go][Go source: syntax highlighting and copying]]

* Review

Follow the links between Org, Markdown and DOCX as well as returning here.
Try folding headings and drawers, selecting text, and copying code.
These synthetic documents contain no personal information.

The original fixture covered reading and navigation while annotations were
pending. The annotation candidate now adds an Annotations button to its Org and
Markdown pages in service mode. Select a short passage, add a comment and wait
for Autosaved draft, then close the comment and return to the page. DOCX, plain
text and code previews remain reading-only.
